scene_description: A small ruins-like structure made entirely of mossy stone bricks is placed 4-7 blocks from spawn in the +X/+Z direction. The structure has a 4x4 base floor, walls on all four sides going up 1 block, and corner pillars going up 2 blocks with a partial front wall at height 2. A small oak planks hut is placed in the -X/-Z direction as environmental scenery. A cow is summoned nearby for ambiance. The player needs to explore and locate the mossy stone bricks structure.
